label: preparing
what: The builder is preparing a great hall arrangement/lighting inspection, with eight installed lanterns and a table layout, and arranging an evening inspection with the mayor. Builder explicitly sought mayor approval, so evidence does not show it was concealed or undertaken without telling the mayor. Freight, baker, and innkeeper are seen around lantern/bread deliveries, but there is no reliable evidence they knowingly assist with the hall preparation; ordinary delivery or stocking is plausible. The bakery celebration rumor was denied and unsubstantiated. Thus a preparation is underway, but not clearly a secret joint plan.
